renderer_requirements.actors: native packed ACT layers/anchors/transforms; flip complete actor and attachments
renderer_requirements.effects: native STR atlas/keyframes or authored procedural family
renderer_requirements.recipes: resolve embedded recipes by reference_skill_id; recipe.runtime/recipe_path are authoring provenance, never dynamic imports

scope: Class1/2 selected media+sidecars only; no asset-library catalogs/archives, no new visual verification

shell.basis: Presentation-only shell selection (TASK-048). Native RO menu/item icons and monster atlases chosen from local metadata; not gameplay data and not part of content_hash. No new manual visual review beyond the 2026-10-20 contact sheet of ro_menu_icon.

boss_pools.note: Story boss look for non-final stages (D-056): stats/skills stay the stage boss row; the chapter-final stage keeps its authored boss sprite.

shell.class_icon_basis: D-135: actual Ragnarok Origin Classic UI_Common_Profession_Icon emblems, mapped by explicit profession id/name/icon in https://roocdb.com/data/classes/professions/asia/en.json. All19 static emblems visually reviewed23October2026. Replaces rejected D-130 skill-art substitutes.

farm.note: Ambient farm waves on the main screen run the shared combat engine for display only. Rewards stay the server farm accrual; waves never grant or change rewards.

awakening_shard.selection_basis: Native RO Abyss Jewel Fragment art, adapted as this game new Awaken currency; not claimed an original RO skill-upgrade item

upgrade.selection_basis: D-136: user explicitly requested an actual RO skill icon containing a plus sign for Upgrade. Native SM_MOVINGRECOVERY has a central plus inside a heart; presentation reuse only, no gameplay effect.

wardrobe.note: Visible headgear/garment chosen by the equipped item tier (D-055). Stats come only from equipment data; armor/shoes/accessory stay invisible like RO.

sizes.download_policy: all files in pack are deployable; fetch initial profile then actors/icons/scenery/audio on demand

ui.icons: selected skill/equipment/card symbols plus shell menu/resource icons
